reviews.text:
We called six pool builders and outlined the scope of our project.  Three never called back at all, one came out and then didn’t ever give an estimate or callback, and two actually pursued our approval.  Of the final two contractors, we chose Fredrick’s for many reasons.  He’s a true Texan that does business with a handshake, tells it to you straight whether you want to hear it or not, and doesn’t ask you for money up front.  He’s built most of the pools in our neighborhood and we’ve heard nothing but amazing things for three years prior to selecting him.  He also lives close to our neighborhood, so being assured that his customers get first class support years later was a big deal for us, as we’ve never built a pool before.

The entire process was super fun, from design phase, to first dig….all the way to clean up.  Fred is good about letting you know when things are happening, what to expect next and when to do what for maintenance.  His crews/sub-contractors were ALWAYS on time or early and were respectful and skilled.  His manager Justin is knowledgeable and easy to work with as well, making a continued relationship after the build easy as pie.  45 days from dig to completion is a pretty big deal as well, quicker than he promised!  He also had no problem with a modular plan, as pool costs these days have ballooned like crazy, and we can’t build the pool house immediately.  He helped us figure out how to make a modular plan work for each step.

The top tier equipment and materials he installs is sleek, beautiful and will save us so much money in electricity.  We couldn’t be happier, esp because we asked for many things he’d not done before.

Fred and Justin rose to this challenge and we have a gorgeous pool, and will be adding on a pool house soon!   Overall, we feel like we got fantastic value for our money!   Thank you Fred!
reviews.author: Summer Odom

reviews.text: Our pool project is just being completed now.  We are really glad we went with this company because they do things right… no cutting corners or trimming back on quality materials or labor to save money. Fred definitely knows what he’s doing and very good at communicating with you. I highly recommend!
reviews.author: David Douglas

reviews.text: We love Fredrick’s Custom Design Pools!  They put our pool in this summer & it is amazing!  Not only was Fred there with us every step of the way during the build, he also continues to help us out when we have questions.  Our experience has been awesome & we defiantly recommend Fredrick’s Custom Pools!
reviews.author: Christie Cox

reviews.text: It was a pleasure working with Fred and his team back in 2022. His professionalism, communication and focus on quality are top notch. We still communicate frequently to this day, and he doesn't hesitate to answer any questions that I may have. Fred is a class act, and our family is grateful we made the decision to trust Fredrick's Custom Design Pools with our dream pool.
reviews.author: Scott Wuenstel

reviews.text: Building a pool is very exciting but we thought for sure it would be stressful. Working with Fredrick was absolutely stress-free. We went with Fred because he is the salesman AND project manager! He didn’t come in and sales us an idea and just dig a hole. He took our general vision and guided us to our final product with his experience. Our project was not cut and dry and all of his advice just made the completion even sweeter without breaking the bank. The guy is straightforward and honest during the process and keeps you updated throughout. We couldn’t ask for a nicer guy to work with. I also want to shout out to his foreman, Justin. Another super good dude and hard worker.
reviews.author: Ty Miller

reviews.text:
Fred's Custom Pool Designs?? Would I give them 5 stars?
NOT ON YOUR LIFE!!
I'd give them ALL the stars if I could! ⭐⭐⭐⭐⭐
After being burned by TWO different pool builders - including one who literally ran off with my money - I was desperate and honestly losing faith in finding an honest contractor. That's when Fred came to my rescue.
When everyone else saw a half-finished disaster, Fred saw an opportunity to make things right. He didn't just finish what others started - he actually took into account what I had already been out financially and worked with me to make the project affordable. Not many contractors would do that!
Fred listened to what I actually needed and wanted, then steered me in the right direction with complete honesty. He understood I'd already been through enough stress and financial strain, so he made sure to help me with the finances too.
In a world where contractors overpromise and underdeliver, Fred does exactly what he says he will do. No surprises, no excuses, no drama - just solid work from people who genuinely care about their customers AND their situations.
If you're looking for a pool builder who will treat your project like it's their own backyard and actually care about your budget after you've been burned before, look no further. Fred's Custom Pool Designs saved my sanity, my dream pool, AND my wallet!
Honest. Reliable. Compassionate. Everything the others weren't.
reviews.author: Sharon whitehead

reviews.text: Fred and his team are wonderful and fun to work with!  Our pool build was not easy due to the amount of rock in our yard and they managed it well and kept us on schedule.  The end product is amazing and we get nothing but compliments from all of our friends and neighbors!  I highly recommend Fred to anyone wanting to build or repair their pool!
reviews.author: Shelina Hartness
